senses.gloss:
m. (-लः)
A rhinoceros.
n. (-लं)
One of the astronomical periods called Karaṇas.
E.
अण् added to तितिल.

m. (-रः)
A francoline partridge.
n. (-रं)
A flock of partridges.
E.
तित्तिर, and अण् affix of aggregation or pleonastic.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Relating to the Tittiri portion of the Vedas, as a student, a text, teacher, section of, &c.
E.
तित्तिरि the Yajur Veda so called, and छ affix; or तित्तिरि a partridge, affix as before; the texts of this Veda being disgorged by YĀJÑAVALKYA in a tangible form, and picked up by the rest of VAIŚAMPĀYANA'S disciples, who, for the purpose, assumed the shape of partridges.

m. (-कः)
A follower of the Tittiri branch of the Vedas.
E.
कन् added to the preceding; also इन् being added तैत्तिरीयिन्, &c.
